command: bash -c SUB=$(az account show --query id -o tsv) && TOKEN=$(az account get-access-token --query accessToken -o tsv) && RESP=$(curl -s 'https://management.azure.com/subscriptions/'$SUB'/resourceGroups/rezolve-AI/providers/Microsoft.MachineLearningServices/workspaces/brainpowa-northeurope/computes/LLM-T1-NC80?api-version=2023-04-01' -H 'Authorization: Bearer '$TOKEN) && echo $RESP | python3 -c 'import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); p=d.get("properties",{}); print(json.dumps({"state":p.get("state"),"provisioningState":p.get("provisioningState")}))'
